item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena finds two steel bars in her school laboratory drawer. One bar is a magnet and the other is a plain iron bar, but they look exactly the same.
She brings one end of bar X near the North pole of bar Y and they attract each other.
Which further test would tell Meena for certain that bar Y is a magnet?

options.A: Check whether bar Y attracts a plain iron nail.
options.B: Check whether the South pole of bar Y also attracts bar X.
options.C: Check whether one end of bar X repels one end of bar Y.
options.D: Check whether bar Y is heavier than bar X.
